items.authored_reason: All six Fisher branches are generated from the closed formula.
All branches and marked time-axis crossings are generated.
Every printed fixed-work curve is generated by saddle inversion.
The full work-time surface and mean-work ridge are generated with a bracketed saddle solve.
The printed quench is executed independently; the physical precession feature is reproduced, while the exact displayed finite-size/thermodynamic protocol is absent from the paper.
The printed quench is executed independently; the decay feature is reproduced, while the exact displayed finite-size/thermodynamic protocol is absent from the paper.
All four quenches use a formula-derived N=256 Majorana-Pfaffian channel; the oscillation period is reproduced, but the paper omits its fit-shift value and Pfaffian size/distance grid.
Ordinary and ground-sector-postselected magnetizations are independently evolved; their printed curve labels are tested as a paper-discrepancy candidate rather than silently swapped.
Half occupation, critical momentum, period, and Loschmidt nonanalyticity are checked.
Normalization, mean-work derivative, Legendre rate, unique zero locus, and zero-work identity are checked.
Diagonal/off-diagonal sector rates and switching times are generated exactly.
The normalized and literal unnormalized expectations are frozen separately.
The normalized characteristic identity and literal source expression are frozen separately.

items.authored_reason: The endpoint occupation contrast plus continuity proves the arbitrary-ramp half-mode claim; independent linear and smoothstep runs are falsification examples, not the definition of the theorem.
